references.text: God calls Abraham to leave his home and family for a reward, which mirrors the promise in Matthew 19:29 about rewards for those who leave home or family for Jesus' sake.
David expresses trust that those who seek the Lord will lack no good thing, paralleling the promise of reward in Matthew 19:29.
Abraham leaves his land in faith, which aligns with the promise of reward for those who leave something for God's kingdom, as mentioned in Matthew 19:29.
This passage about heroes of faith who looked for a heavenly homeland reflects the idea of leaving earthly ties for heavenly promises, similar to what is described in Matthew 19:29.
Peter speaks of an inheritance kept in heaven for believers, which corresponds with the promise of eternal life in Matthew 19:29.
